title: Same Itch, Different World (realistic test)
style: Photorealistic cinematic still, natural light, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look, rich but natural colours, no text, no captions, no watermark, 16:9.

characters.hunter: Young hunter-gatherer man, about 25, lean, light-brown skin, messy spiky dark-brown hair, short stubble, wearing a one-shoulder brown animal-fur tunic tied with a rope belt, barefoot, carrying a long wooden spear with a stone tip.
characters.modern: Young modern man, about 25, short dark-brown hair, light stubble, plain white t-shirt, tired eyes.

voiceover: Forty thousand years ago, a hunter walked through the dry grass of the savanna. Every bush might hide food... or nothing at all. That uncertainty lit up his brain like fire. Today, you lie in a dark bedroom at midnight. Your thumb pulls down the screen. A tiny wheel spins. Maybe something new. Maybe nothing. Same itch. Same brain. Different world. The bush became a feed. The spear became a phone. And the hunt never ends.

scenes.prompt: The hunter walks through tall golden savanna grass at golden hour, spear in hand, acacia trees and distant purple mountains behind him, wide shot.
Close-up of the hunter's hands pushing aside the leaves of a green berry bush, searching, curious expression partly visible, warm light.
The hunter crouches in front of an empty bush with no berries, disappointed, medium shot, dusty savanna.
Night, the hunter's face lit by a campfire, eyes wide and alert, sparks rising, close-up portrait.
The modern man lies in bed in a dark bedroom at midnight, face lit cold blue by his smartphone, a clock on the wall shows 12:00, city lights through the window.
Extreme close-up of a thumb pulling down a smartphone screen to refresh, a small loading spinner at the top of the screen, dark room, blue glow.
Split composition: left half the hunter at a campfire looking at a bush, right half the modern man in bed looking at his phone, both in the same pose and expression, mirrored.
The modern man stands in golden savanna grass at dusk holding his glowing smartphone raised like a spear, silhouette against the sunset, cinematic wide shot.
